notes: INSIDE half of the Rattle Burst (scrap): mismatched capacitor cans, a patched repair hatch, a bare cable stub, amber lamp strip (warm lamps, no clean indicators). charge: lamps fill; fire: the strip stutters (three quick flashes). damaged: a can dented and leaking, a lamp dead, sparks; disabled: dark, cracked, cable torn. Barrel layer rattle_burst_scrap_barrel: three welded barrels of different lengths clamped with rust bands and hazard tape. fire: the three barrels flash in turn (a 3-round burst). Disabled = JAMMED: the middle barrel is bent, a case is stuck in its mouth.
